reference.question: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle B=50^\circ\) and \(\angle C=70^\circ\). \(AD\) bisects \(\angle BAC\) and intersects \(BC\) at \(D\). Find the measure of \(\angle ADB\) in degrees.
reference.solution:
Method 1: Use angle sums and the bisector

\(\angle BAC=180^\circ-50^\circ-70^\circ=60^\circ\), and \(\angle BAD=30^\circ\). In \(\triangle ABD\), \(\angle ADB=180^\circ-50^\circ-30^\circ=100^\circ\).
